checks.detail: Ordinary non-PAE paging uses 1024 u32 entries in each 4096-byte directory/table. checks.detail: Existing write_entry uses ptr::write, not volatile. Same-CPU x86 store ordering plus the compiler barrier is the stated bounded single-vCPU mechanism; verify emitted earlier stores/barrier dominance and final publication, not just source order. INVLPG follows for the two new mappings with no CR3 replacement. No fallible action or callback is allowed in the exposure/commit interval.

After publication, later validation/GDT-install failure retains the complete arena, halts and never reports GREEN.
